name: Azad India Mobility Ltd
summary: Azad India Mobility Limited, together with its subsidiary, NAE Mobility Private Limited, manufactures, assembles, and trades in electric buses and coaches in India. It offers city buses, intercity coaches, airport buses, school buses, executive and luxury coaches, special application buses, and SKD/CKD bus body kits. The company was formerly known as Indian Bright Steel Company Limited and changed its name to Azad India Mobility Limited in May 2024. Azad India Mobility Limited was incorporated in 1960 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.
